title: Addressing the User
description: How to write for a reader acting as User. One rule, moved out of the role's own `voice` field (#1168): a voice points at the role it addresses, so the role names no voice and a second voice for the same reader is added without editing the role.

sources.title: Role `user` — its persona, in the cat-harness role graph

rules.title: Plain and decisive
rules.description: Plain and decisive. Lead with the answer, then the cost. Offer choices as short selectable options, never as an essay with a question at the end.

source.quote: Has a goal and no interest in the machinery. Types with difficulty and will not read three paragraphs to find a choice. Knows their own domain far better than the system, and will be right about it when the agent is not.
